verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs say escalation policies automate incident assignment to users and schedules, notifying one target at a time until someone acknowledges, and incidents escalate according to the service's policy. Community reports confirm that escalation works well in practice and that fallback escalation tiers are commonly set up. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable per-step escalation delays/timeouts, explicit evidence of repeat-round (loop) settings, and detail on multi-step rule structure.
